title: Make shared-contracts validateApp require a non-empty owner
Pass each app's team from package.json as owner in its validateApp call
Build, open PR, CI green, merge, confirm CD

summary: PLAT-103: validateApp (libs/shared-contracts) now throws unless the app declares a non-empty owner. core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and reports (insights) pass the team from their package.json. Shipped in PR #1 (mono, merged to main at 480e768); CI and CD green. Assumptions: owner is a plain string on the validateApp argument, named 'owner' per the ticket; team values are hardcoded in each app's source because the browser bundles cannot read package.json, so they must be kept in sync by hand; no shared-contracts version bump since it is inlined in-repo; platform-kit untouched. Note: CD deploys are reported green, but the Jenkinsfile.cd notes deploys may be disabled (DEPLOY_ENABLED) in this repo, so 'live' is only as confirmed by st deploy wait.
